workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT cell border visibility edges

basis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4.
basis.wireGrammar: TABLEFORMAT border count followed by GRIDFORMAT records; each record carries edge flags, property override flags, border type, color, lineweight, linetype handle, invisibility, and double-line spacing.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored 2x2 TABLECONTENT using the existing tableContentScalarGrid recipe; no drawing fixture files were added.
profile.scope: One cell-style TABLEFORMAT with six one-hot GRIDFORMAT records, one per ODA-defined edge flag.

implementation.behavior: TABLECONTENT output admits one through six visibility-only border records when each record has a unique one-hot edge flag from 0x01 through 0x20. Duplicate edges, grouped edge masks, and other border properties remain refused.
implementation.physicalWire: An independent scalar wire walk checks six GRIDFORMAT spans in order, the preceding group-95 edge flags, the TABLEFORMAT border count, all selected field values, and each closing marker in both encodings.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve all six edge flags and the complete selected border fields.
implementation.failureRetry: Override bit 0x40 is refused while preserving the destination sentinel and caller model; restoring 0x10 permits a same-adapter retry and successful readback.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The only input is authored at test runtime; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limits: Only the AC1027 TABLECONTENT serializer profile is covered; this does not qualify DWG TABLECONTENT output or other DXF versions.
Grouped edge masks, duplicate-edge combinations, border-type/color/lineweight/linetype/double-line overrides remain refused or unqualified.
Serializer wire and typed readback do not establish native CAD rendering, producer coverage, whole-document closure, or public DWG/DXF support claims.
next: Continue with a distinct source- or consumer-backed CONTENTFORMAT, CELLSTYLEMAP, border-property, or grouped-edge profile; retain strict refusal for all unrepresented fields.
